relationships.subject: TNFα-stimulated macrophage conditioned media
relationships.evidence_quote: female DRG neurons specifically demonstrated an increase in neurite outgrowth after incubation with female T‐MCM

relationships.subject: retigabine
relationships.evidence_quote: This effect was abrogated by co‐incubation of T‐MCM with RTG

relationships.subject: KN93
relationships.evidence_quote: treating neurons with KN93 in the presence of T‐MCM significantly attenuated this enhanced growth

relationships.subject: retigabine
relationships.evidence_quote: mice that began treatment with RTG on day 7 displayed a complete reversal of this behavioural hypersensitivity

key_findings: Early DRG excitability induced by inflammatory macrophage media is needed for T-MCM-driven neurite outgrowth; retigabine and the CaMKII inhibitor KN93 block it.
Retigabine suppressed DRG nociceptor firing and reversed pain hypersensitivity in EAE mice.
